what_it_is: Four single-year national Spartina alterniflora binary raster masks ordered from geodata.cn and delivered by the project owner.
Each archive is an ESRI raster stack: uncompressed tiled BigTIFF + .tfw world file + .tif.aux.xml + .tif.ovr pyramid + .tif.vat.dbf value-attribute table (2015 also .tif.vat.cpg = UTF-8).
Positive value 1 = Spartina; background/nodata 255; single band; 30 m nominal pixel size.
1990/2000/2020 use Krasovsky_1940_Albers (central meridian 105E, standard parallels 25N/47N, false easting/northing 0). 2015 uses EPSG:32650 (WGS84 UTM 50N).
what_it_is_not: Not field-verified or GOLD labels; SILVER external reference maps only.

Not a cross-year change product: the four years differ in projection (2015), raster origins, extents and production method; differences between years are not interpretable as change without harmonization.
Not licensed for redistribution: geodata.cn platform terms restrict to scientific research use and prohibit copying/redistribution without written permission.
The 2020 portal abstract describing mangrove (红树林) is a metadata defect, not evidence that the bytes are mangrove (see contradiction_resolution).
